conclusion.root_cause: Ledger-reconciler CronJob (job/9931) launched at 13:40Z on node ip-10-2-3-44 without CPU limits, consuming 3.6-3.8 CPU cores and saturating the shared node to 97-99% CPU utilization. This starved co-located auth-svc pods (auth-svc-77, auth-svc-81) of CPU cycles, causing severe CPU throttling (240-455x baseline throttled periods) and isolated latency spikes (820-1300ms p95) on that node only. Auth-svc pods on other nodes remained healthy (125-132ms p95). All symptoms resolved at 14:12Z when the job completed and node CPU returned to 46% baseline.
